scoring_contract.intermediate_values: Integers between anchors interpolate within the same rubric. Do not imply measured precision beyond evidence.

statuses.numeric: A 0–10 integer is assessed; null means unknown/unassessed. Movie show-only fields are inapplicable and null.
statuses.presence: Use the explicit present/absent/unknown states; never collapse unknown into absence.

scoring_contract.omission: All declared keys are required. Missing keys are contract failures, not zeros or implicit negatives.
scoring_contract.confidence: No calibrated confidence or per-field evidence object is requested. Record assessment_basis honestly; controller-owned source/run records retain actual provenance.
scoring_contract.scope: Every assessment belongs to an explicit movie, whole-show, season, or episode scope with an as-of date and coverage statement.

intensity.10: Exceptionally strong or pervasive in the defined scope.
intensity.1: Supported trace under this rubric. Do not use 1 merely because a weak association is imaginable.

centrality.0: No narrative importance. The content may be absent or present without a meaningful role; use content_presence separately where covered. Zero alone never certifies absence.
centrality.10: Defining focus; removing it fundamentally changes the work.
centrality.1: Supported, very minor narrative importance; occurrence alone is insufficient. Zero means no narrative importance, not certified absence.

membership.0: Does not use the genre conventions.
membership.1: Supported trace under this rubric. Do not use 1 merely because a weak association is imaginable.

prominence.8: Prominent across much of the scope.
prominence.1: Supported trace under this rubric. Do not use 1 merely because a weak association is imaginable.

frequency.1: Supported trace under this rubric. Do not use 1 merely because a weak association is imaginable.

quality.10: Exceptional execution. Absence is not a zero-quality score.
quality.1: Very unsuccessful execution; not a default for unknown quality or absent craft.

suitability.0: Very poor fit under the stated assumptions.
suitability.10: Exceptionally strong fit. Not a universal audience verdict.

separate_dimensions: Genre membership is not subject presence.
Release era is not setting era.
Production origin is not depicted culture or influence.
Intended audience is not age suitability.
Aesthetic appearance does not establish production technique.
Content presence is not narrative importance: a present detail can have centrality zero. Unknown presence and unknown applicability remain explicit.
scoring_contract.advisory_absence: An absent advisory requires sufficient coverage of the relevant scope and version. Do not turn synopsis silence into absence.
scoring_contract.series_policy: Movie scopes require null for every show-only numeric field and facet. Whole-show assessments name covered seasons; no claims about unassessed later releases.

storytelling.chronology.definition: Substantial presentation patterns within scope; select every pattern actually used. Chronological and reverse-chronological strands can coexist. Occasional memories do not establish interleaved timelines; a repeated time loop alone is not reverse chronology. Non-temporal applies to substantial passages not organized by story time.

storytelling.retelling_structure.definition: Ways substantially the same events are presented again from different accounts. Parallel storylines alone do not qualify. Complementary accounts add information; conflicting accounts disagree. Select both when both occur; [] when assessed with neither.

storytelling.tone_progression.definition: Substantial tone patterns within scope, not an exact timeline or a claim about every episode. Select multiple directions if different arcs use them. Broadly stable applies to substantial stable stretches; alternating tones means repeated switching. Comedy and horror blended throughout do not alone establish comic_to_horror.

characters.competence_basis.definition: How focal characters' demonstrated skill is established. These are whole-work categories, not claims that all tags describe the same person. Do not equate intelligence with competence.

presentation.narration_sources.definition: Sources of narration or explanatory speech, excluding ordinary dialogue. First-person character narration does not imply direct audience address. Source recordings are retained historical/archival speech rather than newly added explanation.

presentation.laugh_track.definition: Recorded or live audience laughter included in the soundtrack; ordinary characters laughing is excluded.

presentation.sustained_screaming.definition: Extended or repeatedly sustained screaming in the soundtrack, distinct from an isolated shout or startle.

ending.post_credits_function.definition: Functions of scenes during or after credits within the assessed edition. Select all that apply, including multiple functions in one scene. [] means no qualifying scene/functions; null means undetermined. A comic tag need not reopen a threat.

series.case_resolution_pattern.definition: Recurring case/problem resolution patterns in the assessed episodes. Select all substantial patterns; [] when there is no case/problem structure. Not cancellation status, ending quality or a promise about unseen seasons.

series.character_continuity.definition: Substantial continuity patterns for character relationships/development across the assessed episodes. Resetting some strands and developing others can coexist. Independently assessed from case resolution.

world_context.eras.definition: Substantial depicted story eras, not production dates. A brief mention or prop does not establish a setting. Ancient/medieval are broad temporal labels, not a claim that all societies share one historical periodization.

world_context.relative_periods.definition: Substantial story periods relative to the title's original release, not today. Multiple selections describe the work overall, without pairing each period to an event.

world_context.reality_layers.definition: Kinds of depicted reality that matter to the work. Physical staged reality (e.g. an elaborate set) is distinct from a digital simulation or virtual reality.

world_context.environmental_obstacles.definition: Environmental conditions that materially impede action or survival. Scenic weather alone does not qualify; these tags do not identify who is obstructed or when.

seasonal.depicted_seasons.definition: Substantial seasons depicted, based on the setting's local climate/calendar. Release month and viewing associations are insufficient.

seasonal.depicted_holidays.definition: Named celebrations actually depicted or materially organizing the story. This bounded vocabulary is not exhaustive; do not invent a new label for an unlisted tradition.

cultural.movements_and_traditions.definition: Established artistic affiliation or substantial recognizable stylistic tradition. Country, language, slow pacing or production date alone is insufficient. This list is bounded; unlisted traditions require a future schema revision, not a guessed synonym.

cultural.depicted_contexts.definition: Social/cultural experiences substantially depicted, independently of the production industry or an actor's identity. Diaspora and indigenous contexts require established depiction, not inference from appearance.

representation.established_protagonist_t.definition: Explicitly established traits of protagonists/co-protagonists; tags need not describe the same person. Never infer from actor identity, appearance, names or stereotypes. Adult can overlap older_adult. Older_adult follows the score definition: established about 65+ or explicit late-life/elderly stage in the setting; middle age and parenthood alone do not qualify.

format_facts.production_method.definition: Substantial production methods used. Select both for live-action/animation combinations; ordinary CGI visual effects alone do not make a live-action work animated.

format_facts.narrative_mode.definition: Modes used in substantial passages; select fiction and nonfiction for an explicit hybrid. A fictional mockumentary is fiction, not nonfiction merely because it imitates a documentary.

format_facts.series_structure.definition: Show formats within the supplied scope. Limited means deliberately conceived as a bounded limited series/miniseries, not merely a show that eventually ended or has finitely many released seasons. It can coexist with episodic, serialized or anthology structure. Release/cancellation status does not establish limited format.

format_facts.color_process.definition: Substantial color presentation modes in the assessed edition. Select color and black_and_white if both occur; tinting can coexist with an underlying monochrome image.

format_facts.adaptation_type.definition: Source-material types contributing substantially. Multiple sources may coexist; original refers to substantial independently originated material, not every small adaptation change. Do not invent source-work identifiers.

format_facts.factual_basis.definition: Relationships to real people/events within scope; multiple selections may apply. Disputed is supported factual controversy, not the model being unsure. No selection certifies accuracy.

format_facts.animation_techniques.definition: Animation techniques actually used, not creatures depicted. Select each substantial technique instead of a generic mixed tag.

format_facts.presentation_modes.definition: Observable presentation modes, not audience approval.

format_facts.documentary_devices.definition: Devices used in documentary-style presentation, including fictional mockumentary. Voiceover origin is captured separately.

format_facts.capture_media.definition: Known original capture media. Populate only from specific production knowledge or supplied evidence; otherwise null. A digital streaming release, animation, simulated grain, release date or assumed industry practice does not establish capture medium. Multiple known media may coexist; do not invent components of a mixed-format label.

format_facts.work_relation_types.definition: Known relation types to other works; these tags do not resolve target works or establish influence from resemblance alone.

format_facts.anime_tradition.definition: Affiliation with the anime production/artistic tradition; animation alone is insufficient.

format_facts.silent_or_intertitles.definition: Principally silent-film/intertitle presentation, not simply sparse dialogue.

format_facts.single_take_presentation.definition: Whole work presented as one continuous take, real or simulated; an isolated long take is insufficient.

format_facts.real_time_presentation.definition: Main narrative is presented approximately in real elapsed time; not merely rapid plot events.

format_facts.post_credits_scene_present.definition: A scene during/after credits in this edition, not ordinary credit text.

format_facts.alternate_endings_present.definition: Known alternative endings for this title/edition; do not invent them from narrative ambiguity.

visuals.dominant_colors.definition: Sustained visually dominant on-screen colors, from grading, lighting, costumes or design. Exclude a single prop or fleeting image, posters and assumed symbolism. Multiple selections need not appear together; black/white/gray describe tonal dominance, not automatically monochrome presentation.

visuals.palette_patterns.definition: Substantial on-screen palette relationships, regardless of production technique. Monochromatic means a narrow hue family, not necessarily black-and-white. Analogous uses neighboring hues; complementary uses opposing hues; selective_color isolates colors against subdued/monochrome surroundings; changing_palettes requires substantial palette shifts.

characters.protagonist_motivations.definition: Substantial established motives of protagonists/co-protagonists, not every action or an inferred diagnosis. Whole-work set; wealth and power need not motivate the same person. Revenge is not automatically a tragic-backstory dependence.

characters.protagonist_behavioral_traits.definition: Sustained behavior of protagonists/co-protagonists. Cunning means strategic guile; manipulative means steering others through calculated influence; ruthless means willingness to disregard others welfare for an aim. Self_destructive means repeatedly acting against own welfare. These do not follow automatically from competence, antihero status or identity. Tags may describe different leads.

characters.protagonist_arc_patterns.definition: Substantial protagonist patterns, not inferred from a single mood or scene. Social_alienation is estrangement/exclusion; accumulated_frustration is sustained mounting dissatisfaction; destructive_rebellion is resistance through damaging or destructive acts. They need not co-occur in one protagonist. Other arc attributes remain independently assessed.

groups.types.definition: Kinds of substantially depicted organized groups. Militant requires endorsement or use of combative/coercive force in pursuit of aims, not merely strong beliefs. Ideological describes organizing shared doctrine; political describes political aims. Secrecy, religion, ethnicity or outsider unfamiliarity alone does not establish militancy or coercion.

groups.encounter_perspectives.definition: Sustained focal perspectives through which an organized group is encountered: newcomer joins or enters its world; journalist investigates/reports; undercover conceals investigative identity; visitor remains outside; insider depicts established membership; defector leaves. Whole-work selections need not concern the same group or character.

groups.internal_dynamics.definition: Substantially depicted internal group processes. Operational_methods means showing how a group pursues its aims; mere group presence is insufficient. Select only established processes, not stereotypes about the group type.

relationships.friendship_dynamics.definition: Substantial dynamics within depicted friendships: mutual care, recurring friction, attempted repair, enabling harmful choices, and unresolved strain. Repair does not imply success or complete resolution. Different tags may concern different friendships; not an assertion of realism or overall ending closure.

relationships.romance_social_dynamics.definition: Substantial romantic relationship dynamics: concealment, social disapproval, public scandal or conflicting loyalties. Secrecy is not necessarily shame or infidelity; disapproval needs depiction, not the assessor judging identities. Whole-work tags need not concern the same romance.

world_context.depicted_weather.definition: Substantial perceptible weather/atmospheric conditions, whether scenic or obstructive. Humid requires cues of damp heavy air; tropical geography or rain alone does not establish humidity. Do not infer conditions solely from season, production location or a storm-related plot reference.

world_context.built_environment_characte.definition: Substantial depicted qualities of built surroundings. Old_historic denotes visibly/established older structures; decaying denotes deterioration, independently of age, poverty, haunting or visual beauty.

world_context.depicted_regions.definition: Broad real-world geographical story settings substantially depicted, not filming locations, production countries, character ancestry or travel aspirations. Transregional stories can select multiple. Fictional or unidentified geography stays untagged/unknown rather than guessed; this bounded field does not supply country-level precision.

sound.ambient_sources.definition: Sources with substantial audible environmental presence, independently of narrative importance. Do not infer audible sound from visible objects or setting. Natural ambience can be designed or recorded; this makes no recording-technique claim.

advisory_details.animal_harm_types.definition: Kinds of threatened or actual animal harm depicted or explicitly referred to. Deliberate_cruelty denotes intentional abuse or torment, including neglect; it is distinct from an accidental injury or natural death. Threats can coexist with cruelty. Different tags need not concern the same animal. Unknown parent presence requires null; assessed absent parent requires []; none of these are independently verified exclusion guarantees.

world_context.predominant_eras.definition: Main substantial story eras by narrative emphasis. Multiple selections require genuinely balanced major timelines; a brief flashback is insufficient. Select only eras also assessed in world_context.eras. Unknown remains null.

world_context.depicted_decades.definition: Substantial established story decades normalized to real-world BCE/CE chronology, within the fixed 1800s–2190s vocabulary. Never substitute release decades or copy fictional calendar numbers. Use only when calendar correspondence is established. Null when undetermined; [] when assessed and no listed decade applies. Broad eras can remain known while exact decades/years remain unknown.

world_context.predominant_decades.definition: Main story decades by narrative emphasis, normalized to real-world BCE/CE chronology. Each must occur in depicted_decades. Do not copy a fictional calendar number, release decade or aesthetic period. Null when correspondence or dominant decade is unknown; multiple choices require substantial major timelines.

world_context.earliest_substantial_year.definition: Earliest specifically established substantial story year normalized to real-world BCE/CE. -1 is 1 BCE and 1 is 1 CE; no year zero. Never use release years, costume/set aesthetics, broad era estimates or unconverted fictional-calendar numbers. Null unless this exact boundary and its calendar correspondence are known; a known decade need not imply known year bounds. Brief flashbacks do not set substantial bounds.

world_context.latest_substantial_year.definition: Latest specifically established substantial story year normalized to real-world BCE/CE. -1 is 1 BCE and 1 is 1 CE; no year zero. Never use release years, costume/set aesthetics, broad era estimates or unconverted fictional-calendar numbers. Null unless this exact boundary and its calendar correspondence are known; a known decade need not imply known year bounds. A range does not assert continuous coverage.

world_context.calendar_systems.definition: Calendar systems or established chronology correspondence for substantial story settings. real_world_ce_bce means established correspondence with real-world historical chronology, including alternate histories retaining that calendar. other_real_world means an identified non-CE real-world calendar; fictional means an invented calendar or epoch. If a non-CE or fictional calendar has an explicitly known BCE/CE conversion, also select real_world_ce_bce. Multiple can coexist. Do not infer from a four-digit year, release date or contemporary appearance. Null if undetermined; [] if assessed with no established calendar. Numeric year/decade fields always require known BCE/CE correspondence; this field does not supply a conversion.

advisory_topics.violence: Physical violence or intentional bodily harm.
advisory_topics.gore: Graphic wounds, blood, or bodily destruction.
advisory_topics.nudity: Depicted nudity, independently of sexual activity.
advisory_topics.substance_use: Use of intoxicating or addictive substances.
advisory_topics.disturbing_imagery: Imagery likely to be upsetting through its content rather than plot stakes alone.
advisory_topics.child_endangerment: Threatened or actual harm to a child.
advisory_topics.animal_harm: Threatened or actual injury, cruelty, or death affecting an animal.
advisory_topics.self_harm: Intentional self-injury, separately from suicidal behavior.
advisory_topics.suicide: Suicidal ideation, attempts, or death by suicide.
advisory_topics.sexual_violence: Sexual assault, coercive sexual conduct, or threats of such conduct.
advisory_topics.domestic_abuse: Abuse within intimate or domestic relationships.
advisory_topics.police_brutality: Abusive force or treatment by police.
advisory_topics.torture: Deliberate infliction of severe suffering on a captive or controlled person.
advisory_topics.pregnancy_loss: Miscarriage, stillbirth, or other loss of a pregnancy.
advisory_topics.discrimination: Discriminatory abuse or exclusion. This bounded advisory records presence and depiction, not an identified target or a free-text note.
advisory_topics.flashing_imagery: Flashing or strobing imagery; an editorial observation is not a technical accessibility certification.
advisory_topics.death: Human or animal death occurring, shown, implied or explicitly discussed within the work, including natural/nonviolent and offscreen death. Ordinary mortality as an abstract theme alone is insufficient. Do not infer absence from low violence, low stakes or synopsis silence.
